items.title: OpenAI’s Navier-Stokes release included a Lean 4 formal proof
items.blurb: When OpenAI released their proof that solutions to the Navier-Stokes equations can blow up in finite time, they also released a formal proof in Lean 4.

items.blurb: Today we’re introducing SWE-2, our most advanced coding model yet. SWE-2 delivers highly competitive agentic coding performance across multiple effort…

items.title: tsgolint Reaches Stable v7, Bringing Go-Powered Type-Aware Linting to Oxlint
items.blurb: tsgolint has released a stable v7, enhancing TypeScript linting with native Go speed. It offers type-aware linting, leveraging TypeScript's semantic analysis through the typescript-go compiler.

items.title: AWS Lambda recursive loop detection is now available in Europe Sovereign Cloud
items.blurb: AWS Lambda recursive loop detection is now supported for functions running in Europe Sovereign Cloud.

items.title: AWS Transform for .NET now generates unit tests for modernized code
items.blurb: Today, AWS announced that AWS Transform for .NET can automatically generate unit tests for the code it modernizes.

items.title: Amazon API Gateway now supports 1 MB execution logs with configurable delivery destinations
items.blurb: Amazon API Gateway now supports configurable delivery destinations and larger log events for REST API execution logs.

items.title: AWS Lambda durable functions integrates with Pydantic AI
items.blurb: Today, AWS Lambda durable functions announces an integration with Pydantic AI , an open source framework for building AI agents in Python.

items.title: Amazon MQ now supports RabbitMQ 4.3
items.blurb: Amazon MQ now supports RabbitMQ version 4.3 which adds quorum queue feature enhancements such as compaction, increased priority levels, native delayed retries, and graceful consumer timeouts.

items.title: Announcing second-generation single-rack AWS Outposts
items.blurb: Today, AWS announces the general availability of second-generation single-rack AWS Outposts, a self-contained 42U rack that integrates compute, storage and networking into a single compact unit purpose-built for workloads requiring low…

items.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-6 Astra for Coding and Computer Use
items.blurb: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Astra, a new model focused on coding, computer use, long-running agentic tasks, and cybersecurity, with availability across ChatGPT, Codex, and the OpenAI API. By Daniel Dominguez
